description: [provider] Search people by title, seniority, company or location. Search Apollo's 200M+ contacts by title, seniority, company, location or tech (free) (Apollo.io · People & contact data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: query-string params on a POST, with arrays in field[]=value form. RETURNS NO EMAILS OR PHONE NUMBERS AT ALL — that is why it is free. Pipe the person ids into apollo.people.enrich to get contact data, which is where the credits go. Result set is capped at 50,000 records

contact_email_status[].description: verified, unverified, likely to engage, unavailable

person_seniorities[].description: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern

person_titles[].description: job titles, matched loosely (OR across the list)

q_organization_domains_list[].description: restrict to employees of these company domains; max 1,000

revenue_range[min].description: annual revenue floor, integer with no symbols

name: apollo_people_search
